fullName: TC-14 In-Room Dictation & Note Generation › TC-14/probe-generate-overwrite
name: [local] probe-generate-overwrite Two devices: while device A's Hospital Generate Note & Finish waits for the model, a line typed on device B is saved; when A's note returns, its second save writes back the text A captured at the tap and B's line is gone from the server, and after a reload from device B too.
